meta.description: Keyword cluster catalog, schema 3.1. Adds a CONDITION axis: meta.therapeutic_areas[] and meta.indications[] registries (MeSH-anchored), and a required clusters[].indication FK into meta.indications[]. The analysis UI toggles by indication; clusters with indication "general" are condition-agnostic and shown under every toggle. Each cluster also declares parent_theme + parent_subtheme as FKs into codebook.json. Variants are SUGGESTION FUEL ONLY — they rank cluster suggestions in the segment tag drawer; they do NOT auto-tag any occurrence. Per-instance tag rows live in keyword_tags.json keyed by (cluster_id, segment_id, char_start, char_end).
changelog: 3.0-draft — replaced the `categories[].keywords[]` shape with a flat `clusters[]` keyed by parent_theme + parent_subtheme. The 102 clusters from keyword_lexicon.json @ 2.0 will be re-classified via the codebook-migration map in codebook_migration_map.json; some will split into parallel clusters with different parents (e.g. cost as a treatment vs. trial barrier).

3.0-draft (porting pass) — ported 103 clusters from keyword_lexicon.json @ 2.0 via scripts/migrate-keyword-lexicon.mjs. Each cluster carries parent_theme + parent_subtheme assigned by category default + per-cluster overrides. Descriptions are empty for now; analyst should backfill as part of Phase 0 review.

3.0 — variant expansion pass. Bug-fixed semaglutide cluster (removed stray 'positive' and incorrect 'eli lilly' variants; 'eli lilly' now correctly lives on tirzepatide). Added manufacturer semantic links: semaglutide ↔ novo nordisk/novo/rybelsus; tirzepatide ↔ eli lilly/lilly. Expanded high-traffic clusters (glp_1, injection, oral_medication, dosing_schedule, diabetes, glucose_monitoring, fasting_blood, travel_burden, visit_frequency, trial_site, clinical_trial, placebo, randomized, financial_compensation, side_effects, needle_phobia, weight_maintenance, weight_loss, weight_regain, hunger, food_noise, quality_of_life, obesity, shortages, coverage, insurance, prior_authorization, healthcare_benefits, scary, meal_replacement, gastric_effects, complication, stall, safety, risk, convenience, support, compounded_medication). Added 13 new clusters: a1c, bmi, sleep_apnea, pcos, thyroid, fda_approval, long_term_use, research_self, diet_exercise, previous_weight_loss, transparency, cost_prohibitive. Backfilled descriptions on every touched cluster. Backup of prior live: keyword_lexicon.v2-backup.json.

3.1 — added the condition axis. New meta.therapeutic_areas[] (Endocrinology, Allergy and Immunology, Nephrology) and meta.indications[] (general, obesity, lupus_nephritis) registries, both MeSH-anchored. Every cluster gained an "indication" FK: 64 backfilled to "general" (cross-cutting), the rest to "obesity". Appended 63 lupus_nephritis clusters (Immunology + Nephrology) across medications, symptoms, quality-of-life, renal labs, comorbidities, barriers, decision factors, self-management, stigma, and lupus-specific trial endpoints. Cross-cutting facets (cost, insurance, trial logistics) are NOT duplicated per condition — they stay under "general". Backup of prior live: keyword_lexicon.v3-backup.json. Migration: scripts/migrate-lexicon-conditions.mjs.

cluster_shape.id: Slug, lowercase + underscores. Globally unique. Example: 'treatment_cost_concerns'.
cluster_shape.label: Display label. Example: 'Treatment cost concerns'.
cluster_shape.description: One sentence describing what the cluster covers.
cluster_shape.parent_subtheme: FK → codebook.next.json themes[].subthemes[].id. Required. The named subtheme must belong to the named parent_theme.
cluster_shape.variants: Array of lowercase surface forms (spellings, plurals, brand/generic pairs, multi-word phrasings) used to RANK this cluster's suggestion priority when an analyst highlights a phrase in the drawer. Matching is case-insensitive, with hyphen/space runs treated as equivalent. Not used for auto-tagging.
cluster_shape.indication: FK → meta.indications[].id. Required. Use "general" for condition-agnostic clusters (trial mechanics, cost/access, visit logistics) so they surface under every condition toggle; otherwise the specific indication this cluster pertains to.

matching_notes: Matching for suggestions is case-insensitive. Within a variant, runs of spaces/hyphens match any run of whitespace or hyphens (so 'out of pocket' also matches 'out-of-pocket').
Variants with no separator (e.g. 'glp1') are listed explicitly because the separator in multi-word variants is required, not optional.
Brand and generic names for the same molecule should be grouped under one cluster (e.g. semaglutide groups Wegovy/Ozempic).
Suggestion ranking may additionally weight clusters by the segment's current theme/subtheme tags — clusters whose parent_subtheme matches a tagged subtheme float to the top.

If the same surface concept needs to belong under different parent subthemes (e.g. cost as a Treatment Barrier vs. as a Trial Barrier), create two clusters with parallel names and different parent_subtheme values — do NOT add a cluster to multiple parents.

example_cluster.label: Treatment cost concerns
example_cluster.description: Out-of-pocket cost, insurance friction, and affordability as obstacles to starting or continuing treatment.

indications.label: Condition-agnostic
indications.description: Cross-cutting clusters that apply regardless of condition — trial mechanics, cost/access, visit logistics, and generic decision/knowledge/adverse-event language. Always shown alongside whichever condition is toggled on.

indications.label: Obesity
indications.description: GLP-1 weight-management corpus (WCT GLP-1 interviews). Metabolic comorbidities (diabetes, PCOS, sleep apnea) sit under this indication as comorbidities.

indications.label: Lupus Nephritis
indications.description: Kidney manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Spans induction/maintenance immunosuppression, renal labs, and progression to CKD/ESRD.

clusters.label: Clinical trial
clusters.description: Generic references to clinical trials — participation, enrollment, phases.

clusters.label: Placebo
clusters.description: Inactive comparator used in controlled trials — sugar pill, control arm, double-blind designs.

clusters.label: Randomized
clusters.description: Random assignment to study arms — odds of getting drug vs. placebo.

clusters.label: Dosing schedule
clusters.description: How often the dose is taken — weekly, monthly, every two weeks, etc.

clusters.label: Fasting blood
clusters.description: Fasted blood draws — typically requiring 8–12 hours without food before the visit.

clusters.label: Travel burden
clusters.description: Time, distance, and effort to physically reach a trial site — driving, flying, commuting.

clusters.label: Trial site / clinic
clusters.description: The physical location where trial visits happen — site, clinic, study center, hospital.

clusters.label: Visit frequency
clusters.description: How often trial visits occur — weekly, monthly, every few weeks.

clusters.label: Convenience
clusters.description: Ease and simplicity as a trial motivator — convenient logistics, fewer obstacles.

clusters.label: Financial compensation
clusters.description: Money paid to trial participants — stipend, reimbursement, payment for time.

clusters.label: Provider transparency
clusters.description: Wanting clear, upfront communication from the study team / providers.

clusters.label: Support
clusters.description: Support sources — family, community, peer groups, providers.

clusters.label: Cost prohibitive
clusters.description: Cost framed as absolutely blocking access — not just expensive, but impossible.

clusters.label: Coverage
clusters.description: Whether the drug is covered by insurance — formulary status, network, plan rules.

clusters.label: Healthcare / employer benefits
clusters.description: How employer-provided healthcare and benefits shape access to GLP-1s.

clusters.label: Insurance
clusters.description: Insurance plan, carrier, and policy as gatekeepers to access.

clusters.label: Needle phobia
clusters.description: Fear of needles or injections as a barrier to treatment uptake.

clusters.label: Prior authorization
clusters.description: Insurer pre-approval requirement gating prescription fills — PAs, pre-auth, step therapy.

clusters.label: Shortages
clusters.description: Supply disruptions making the drug unavailable — shortages, stockouts, manufacturing gaps.

clusters.label: Side effects (as barrier)
clusters.description: Side effects framed as a reason not to start or to stop treatment.

clusters.label: Long-term use
clusters.description: Indefinite or lifelong drug use — "rest of my life," chronic-treatment framing.

clusters.label: Self-research
clusters.description: Independently researching drugs, forums, COIs, certificates — DIY due diligence.

clusters.label: Risk
clusters.description: Risk language as a decision factor — explicit risk weighing, risk-benefit framing.

clusters.label: Scary / scared
clusters.description: Fear language as a decision factor — scared, frightened, anxious about an outcome.

clusters.label: Injection / shot
clusters.description: Subcutaneous injection delivery — pens, syringes, weekly/monthly shots.

clusters.label: Oral medication / pill
clusters.description: Pill, tablet, or capsule delivery — taken by mouth.

clusters.label: FDA approval
clusters.description: Regulatory approval status — FDA approved, approval pathways, regulator references.

clusters.label: Safety
clusters.description: Drug safety language — safe/unsafe, long-term safety, risk profile.

clusters.label: Health complication
clusters.description: Serious medical complications attributed to or risked by treatment.

clusters.label: Side effects
clusters.description: Unintended drug effects — both reported in trials (adverse events) and lived experience.

clusters.label: Continuous glucose monitoring
clusters.description: CGMs, finger pricks, and other blood-glucose tracking methods.

clusters.label: Meal replacement
clusters.description: Shakes, protein drinks, and meal boxes offered as trial perks or for nutrition support.

clusters.label: A1C / HbA1c
clusters.description: Hemoglobin A1c — three-month average blood sugar; common diabetes/pre-diabetes lab marker.

clusters.label: BMI
clusters.description: Body mass index references — used as a clinical eligibility / progress marker.

clusters.label: Diabetes
clusters.description: Type 1 or type 2 diabetes — diagnosis, management, family history.

clusters.label: PCOS
clusters.description: Polycystic ovary syndrome — a common GLP-1 adjacent comorbidity.

clusters.label: Sleep apnea
clusters.description: Sleep apnea as a comorbidity often linked to obesity; CPAP usage.

clusters.label: Thyroid
clusters.description: Thyroid conditions and history — relevant to GLP-1 boxed warnings.

clusters.label: Diet and exercise (paired)
clusters.description: The paired "diet and exercise" framing — the traditional, often-tried-and-failed alternative to GLP-1s.

clusters.label: Food noise
clusters.description: Intrusive, persistent thoughts about food that GLP-1s often quiet.

clusters.label: Previous weight loss attempts
clusters.description: Prior weight-loss attempts that failed, succeeded briefly, or set up the current attempt.

clusters.label: Stigma
clusters.description: Stigma towards obesity as disease.

clusters.label: Obesity / overweight
clusters.description: Identification with the condition — obesity-as-disease framing, overweight, BMI category.

clusters.label: Weight regain
clusters.description: Putting weight back on after stopping or reducing treatment — yo-yo, rebound.

clusters.label: Compounded medication
clusters.description: Compounding-pharmacy versions of GLP-1s used during shortages or as cheaper alternatives.

clusters.label: GLP-1
clusters.description: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist drug class.

clusters.label: Orforglipron
clusters.description: Eli Lilly's experimental oral, non-peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist (in development).

clusters.label: Semaglutide (Wegovy / Ozempic / Rybelsus)
clusters.description: Novo Nordisk's GLP-1 receptor agonist molecule — sold as Wegovy (weight loss), Ozempic (T2D), and Rybelsus (oral).

clusters.label: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro / Zepbound)
clusters.description: Eli Lilly's dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist — sold as Mounjaro (T2D) and Zepbound (weight loss).

clusters.label: Gastric effects
clusters.description: GI side effects on GLP-1s — nausea, vomiting, constipation, slowed gastric emptying.

clusters.label: Stall / plateau
clusters.description: Weight-loss stalls and plateaus on treatment — the scale stops moving.

clusters.label: Hunger / appetite / satiety
clusters.description: Appetite signals — hunger, cravings, fullness, satiety changes on GLP-1s.

clusters.label: Quality of life
clusters.description: Felt life improvement from treatment — energy, confidence, dramatic change.

clusters.label: Weight loss
clusters.description: Active weight loss — pounds lost, percent body weight, the loss phase.

clusters.label: Weight maintenance
clusters.description: Holding weight stable after loss — the maintenance phase of treatment.

clusters.label: Renal response endpoint
clusters.description: Lupus nephritis trial outcome measures — complete renal response, proteinuria reduction, eGFR preservation.

clusters.label: Lupus support / advocacy
clusters.description: Patient communities, foundations, and peer support for people with lupus and lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Anemia / cytopenias
clusters.description: Low blood counts — anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia — from lupus or its treatment.

clusters.label: Antiphospholipid syndrome
clusters.description: Clotting disorder frequently co-occurring with lupus; raises thrombosis and pregnancy risks.

clusters.label: Cardiovascular disease
clusters.description: Elevated heart and vascular risk in lupus — pericarditis, accelerated atherosclerosis, clots.

clusters.label: Chronic kidney disease (CKD)
clusters.description: Progressive loss of kidney function that can result from lupus nephritis; staged by eGFR.

clusters.label: Dialysis
clusters.description: Hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis to replace kidney function in advanced lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Kidney failure / ESRD
clusters.description: End-stage renal disease requiring dialysis or transplant — the outcome lupus nephritis treatment aims to prevent.

clusters.label: Kidney transplant
clusters.description: Transplantation as treatment for kidney failure from lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Osteoporosis / bone loss
clusters.description: Reduced bone density, often from long-term steroid use in lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Autoantibodies (ANA / anti-dsDNA)
clusters.description: Lupus autoantibodies — ANA, anti-dsDNA, anti-Smith — used for diagnosis and tracking disease activity.

clusters.label: Complement levels (C3 / C4)
clusters.description: Low complement (C3, C4) reflects active lupus; tracked alongside autoantibodies.

clusters.label: Creatinine
clusters.description: Serum creatinine — a blood marker of kidney function; rising values signal worsening lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: eGFR / kidney function
clusters.description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate — the core measure of how well the kidneys filter; tracked over time in lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Kidney biopsy / ISN class
clusters.description: Renal biopsy that diagnoses lupus nephritis and assigns its histologic class (ISN/RPS Class I–VI).

clusters.label: Urine protein (UPCR / 24-hour)
clusters.description: Urine protein-to-creatinine ratio or 24-hour collection quantifying proteinuria — the key lupus nephritis response measure.

clusters.label: Blood pressure monitoring
clusters.description: Home blood-pressure tracking to manage renal hypertension in lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Symptom / lab tracking
clusters.description: Logging symptoms, labs, and flares to manage lupus nephritis and communicate with the care team.

clusters.label: Medication adherence
clusters.description: Sticking to complex lupus regimens consistently — a core self-management skill.

clusters.label: Low-sodium / renal diet
clusters.description: Dietary changes — reducing salt, sometimes protein or potassium — to support kidney health.

clusters.label: Sun protection
clusters.description: Sunscreen, protective clothing, and sun avoidance to prevent UV-triggered lupus flares.

clusters.label: Appearance changes / stigma
clusters.description: Self-consciousness about steroid weight gain, moon face, hair loss, or rashes from lupus and its treatment.

clusters.label: Invisible illness
clusters.description: The challenge of a serious illness others can't see — feeling disbelieved or having to explain lupus.

clusters.label: Fever / constitutional symptoms
clusters.description: Low-grade fevers, night sweats, and malaise during active lupus.

clusters.label: Reduced / changed urine output
clusters.description: Producing less urine or noticing changes in urination — a sign of declining kidney function.

clusters.label: Edema / swelling
clusters.description: Fluid retention causing swelling in the legs, ankles, feet, or around the eyes — common in nephrotic-range lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Fatigue
clusters.description: Persistent, often debilitating tiredness — among the most common and disruptive lupus symptoms.

clusters.label: Hair loss / alopecia
clusters.description: Diffuse hair thinning or patchy loss from lupus activity or treatment.

clusters.label: Hematuria / blood in urine
clusters.description: Blood in the urine, visible or microscopic — a sign of active kidney inflammation.

clusters.label: Joint pain / arthralgia
clusters.description: Aching, stiff, or swollen joints — frequent in systemic lupus.

clusters.label: High blood pressure (renal)
clusters.description: Elevated blood pressure driven by kidney involvement in lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Lupus flare / renal flare
clusters.description: Periods of disease reactivation — systemic or kidney-specific — with worsening labs and symptoms.

clusters.label: Lupus nephritis (diagnosis)
clusters.description: Identification with the condition — lupus / SLE-related kidney disease as the diagnosis being lived with.

clusters.label: Malar / butterfly rash
clusters.description: The characteristic facial rash across the cheeks and nose bridge; photosensitive skin involvement in lupus.

clusters.label: Nephrotic syndrome
clusters.description: Heavy proteinuria with low blood albumin, swelling, and high cholesterol — a severe presentation of lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Mouth ulcers / sores
clusters.description: Painless oral or nasal ulcers — a classification criterion for lupus.

clusters.label: Photosensitivity / sun sensitivity
clusters.description: Skin and systemic flares triggered by sun or UV exposure.

clusters.label: Proteinuria / foamy urine
clusters.description: Protein leaking into the urine — the hallmark sign of lupus nephritis; often noticed as foamy or frothy urine.

clusters.label: Raynaud's phenomenon
clusters.description: Color changes and numbness in fingers and toes with cold or stress — common in lupus.

clusters.label: Fertility concerns
clusters.description: Worry about infertility from cyclophosphamide and pregnancy risk on teratogenic drugs — a major barrier for patients of childbearing age.

clusters.label: Pill burden / regimen complexity
clusters.description: The load of taking many medications on strict schedules — a barrier to adherence in lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Avoiding dialysis / kidney failure
clusters.description: Preventing progression to dialysis or transplant as the central motivation behind lupus nephritis treatment decisions.

clusters.label: Steroid-sparing goal
clusters.description: Wanting to minimize or get off steroids as a driver of treatment choices.

clusters.label: ACE inhibitor / ARB (renoprotective)
clusters.description: Renin-angiotensin blockers (lisinopril, losartan) used to lower proteinuria and protect kidney function.

clusters.label: Anifrolumab (Saphnelo)
clusters.description: Type-I interferon receptor antagonist approved for SLE and studied in lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Azathioprine (Imuran)
clusters.description: Immunosuppressant used for lupus nephritis maintenance, including during pregnancy.

clusters.label: Belimumab (Benlysta)
clusters.description: Anti-BLyS/BAFF monoclonal antibody approved for lupus nephritis; IV infusion or subcutaneous injection.

clusters.label: Calcineurin inhibitors (tacrolimus / cyclosporine)
clusters.description: Tacrolimus and cyclosporine — calcineurin inhibitors used alone or in multi-target therapy for lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Corticosteroids (prednisone)
clusters.description: Glucocorticoids — prednisone, methylprednisolone pulses — the backbone of induction therapy, tapered over time.

clusters.label: Cyclophosphamide (Cytoxan)
clusters.description: Alkylating immunosuppressant for induction in severe lupus nephritis; given IV (NIH or Euro-Lupus regimens) or orally.

clusters.label: Hydroxychloroquine (Plaquenil)
clusters.description: Antimalarial background therapy recommended for nearly all lupus patients; reduces flares and renal damage.

clusters.label: IV infusion
clusters.description: Intravenous infusion delivery for biologics and IV cyclophosphamide — infusion-center visits.

clusters.label: Multi-target / combination therapy
clusters.description: Combining agents (e.g. mycophenolate + calcineurin inhibitor + steroid) to induce remission in lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Mycophenolate (CellCept / Myfortic)
clusters.description: Mycophenolate mofetil / mycophenolic acid — first-line immunosuppressant for lupus nephritis induction and maintenance.

clusters.label: Obinutuzumab (Gazyva)
clusters.description: Anti-CD20 antibody investigated for lupus nephritis (REGENCY trial).

clusters.label: Rituximab (Rituxan)
clusters.description: Anti-CD20 B-cell-depleting antibody used off-label for refractory lupus nephritis.

clusters.label: Voclosporin (Lupkynis)
clusters.description: Calcineurin inhibitor approved 2021 for active lupus nephritis, added on top of mycophenolate and steroids.

clusters.label: Cyclophosphamide toxicity
clusters.description: Bladder toxicity, nausea, and being treated with what feels like chemotherapy.

clusters.label: Infections (immunosuppression)
clusters.description: Frequent or serious infections resulting from immunosuppressive lupus nephritis treatment.

clusters.label: Nausea / GI effects (mycophenolate)
clusters.description: Gastrointestinal upset — nausea, diarrhea, cramping — commonly from mycophenolate.

clusters.label: Steroid side effects
clusters.description: Weight gain, moon face, mood swings, insomnia, and bone loss from long-term steroid use.

clusters.label: Quality of life (lupus)
clusters.description: Felt impact of lupus and its treatment on daily life — energy, function, independence, getting back to normal.

clusters.label: Renal remission / response
clusters.description: Achieving complete or partial renal response — proteinuria falling and kidney function stabilizing on treatment.
